evidence.content: Hi Cameron, I'm preparing an onboarding checklist for a new data analyst starting September 9, reporting to Nora. Accounts listed: email, analytics workspace, issue tracker. Do you have any practical role-specific items I should add (e.g., timing of account provisioning, access requests, first-week steps)? A short reply is fine.
The onboarding specialist knows analysts need read-only access to the sanitized warehouse before the first training session.
